modern: Look round at the courses of the stars, as if you were moving along with them; and constantly consider the changes of the elements into one another, for such thoughts wash away the filth of life on earth.
original: Look round at the courses of the stars, as if thou wert going along with them; and constantly consider the changes of the elements into one another, for such thoughts purge away the filth of the terrene life.
notification: Look round at the courses of the stars, as if you were moving along with them;
